candidates.reason: Unit tests for the reactorless shutdown signal handlers of AsyncCrawlerProcess (scrapy/crawler.py: _signal_shutdown_reactorless, _signal_kill_reactorless). They construct a bare process with __new__, stub scrapy.crawler.install_shutdown_handlers, and assert exactly which callbacks are scheduled on the event loop, including loop.call_soon_threadsafe.assert_not_called() in test_signal_kill_reactorless_without_main_task. Moving _log_shutdown/_log_kill off the handler and onto loop.call_soon_threadsafe changes those expectations, so this is the primary file to update and run.

End-to-end subprocess tests that start a real crawl, deliver SIGINT (SIGBREAK on Windows) and assert the stderr text produced by the shutdown signal handlers: 'shutting down gracefully' from _log_shutdown and 'forcing unclean shutdown' from _log_kill, on both the Twisted reactor and reactorless paths. They are the only tests that exercise the changed handlers against a live reactor/event loop, so they verify the messages still reach the log after logging is deferred out of the handler.
